WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(extras_type, '')) NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS legal_balls,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(extras_type, '')) IN ('byes', 'legbyes', 'penalty')
        THEN batsman_runs
        ELSE total_runs
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  ROUND(runs_conceded * 6.0 / legal_balls, 2) AS economy
FROM bowler_stats
WHERE legal_balls >= 1000
ORDER BY runs_conceded * 6.0 / legal_balls ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      total_runs
      - CASE
          WHEN extras_type IN ('byes', 'legbyes', 'penalty') THEN extra_runs
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN is_wicket = 1
         AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS wickets
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) / wickets AS bowling_average
FROM bowling_stats
WHERE wickets >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner AS winning_team, SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries d
JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
WHERE d.inning = 2 AND d.batting_team = m.winner
GROUP BY d.match_id, m.winner
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wickets
FROM deliveries
WHERE over BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wickets DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
FROM deliveries
WHERE batter NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed FROM deliveries WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN toss_decision = 'field' AND toss_winner = winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM matches

WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT team1 AS team, id FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team, id FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
),
team_stats AS (
    SELECT
        tm.team,
        COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner = tm.team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
    FROM team_matches tm
    JOIN matches m ON tm.id = m.id
    GROUP BY tm.team
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT team, (wins * 100.0 / matches_played) AS win_percentage
FROM team_stats
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, player_dismissed AS batter, COUNT(*) AS dismissal_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler, player_dismissed
ORDER BY dismissal_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(inn1_total) AS avg_first_innings_total
FROM (
    SELECT match_id, SUM(total_runs) AS inn1_total
    FROM deliveries
    WHERE inning = 1
    GROUP BY match_id
) t
JOIN matches m ON m.id = t.match_id
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS second_batting_team
    FROM deliveries
    WHERE inning = 2
) d2 ON d2.match_id = m.id
WHERE m.winner = d2.second_batting_team
